component.name: ShadowPlayer
component.summary: Audiophile playback for the music you already own

description.p: ShadowPlayer is a local-first desktop music player built in Rust: bit-perfect output, a studio-grade DSP chain, a 100,000-track library that stays fast, and zero accounts, cloud dependencies, or telemetry.

ul.li: Verified bit-perfect output with live hardware transformation ledger
Studio-grade DSP chain: Parametric EQ, Cytomic SVF, Graphic EQ, and CLAP plugin rack
Non-Uniform Partitioned Convolution (NUPC) and real-time neural declipping
Acoustic alignment suite with 2D soundstage geometry and arrival delay physics
Calibrated binaural crossfeed (Bauer, Chu Moy, Jan Meier) with cranial shadow modeling
Autonomous multi-zone playback with quartz crystal clock drift compensation
High-scale library virtualization rendering 100,000 tracks in 0.23 ms per frame
Local-first privacy: on-device recommendation mix and local SQLite storage
Customizable themes with WCAG AA contrast enforcement and .stm theme editor

description.p: Complete secondary localization (DE/FR/ES/JA/ZH/HI 100%), .stm theme format migration, and multi-platform packaging pipeline.
Settings dual-persona overhaul, full-spectrum HSV color wheel, quick-tune EQ studio, and audio engine 1.14.0.
